import numpy as np
import limited_client as robot
obs=robot.observe(camera=2)
K=np.asarray(obs['intrinsic']); T=np.asarray(obs['camera_to_world']); D=obs['depth_m']

    p=np.linalg.inv(K)@np.array([u,v,1.])*d
    w=T@np.r_[p,1.]
    print((u,v),'depth',d,'world',w[:3])
print('robot',obs['robot'])
